headline: Last session: Indian markets extended winning streak to 4 weeks as Sensex and Nifty hit 9-month highs.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Record Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) buying boosted market momentum.
Banking, auto, and IT stocks supported market recovery from lower opening levels.
Global sell-off in AI stocks and Fed rate hike signals temporarily weighed on investor sentiment.
Benchmark indices gained around 3% over the week despite underperformance in smallcaps.
whatHappening: Nifty 50 and Sensex extended their weekly winning streak to four consecutive weeks.
Banking and IT stocks helped indices recover mid-day after opening lower due to global AI concerns.
Kirloskar group firms secured a ₹366 crore pump order from a Nigerian refinery.
NSE stock price rose 5% on heavy volume, extending its rally to 35% from October lows.
summary:
During the last trading sessions, Indian equities extended their winning streak to four weeks as Sensex and Nifty touched 9-month highs.
Strong support from banking, IT, and auto stocks helped markets recover from global AI tech sell-off concerns.
Key corporate updates included Kirloskar winning a ₹366 crore overseas pump contract and strong gains in NSE shares.
